description: Office of the Governor - Uva Province - Appointed as 3 members for Road Passenger Transport Services Authority, Provincial Library Services and Rent Board of Uva Province
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Mr. Dayananda Rathnayake, Mrs. G.A.M.S.P. Ambanwala, Mrs. E.P.A. Sriyakanthi) AND detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities and duties (e.g., "bearing Member of the Director Board of the Road Passenger Transport Service Authority," "perform the duties of the Chairman of the Library Service Board," "Authorized Officer of the Rent Board"). This combination of people and detailed responsibilities meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
